events.text: The ingest entry point also needs to persist parsed transcripts so the eval harness can pick them up — one JSON file per transcript under an out dir.

events.diff:
+def write_transcripts(transcripts: list[Transcript], out_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
+    """Write each transcript to ``out_dir`` as ``<id>.json``; return the paths."""
+    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    written: list[Path] = []
+    for transcript in transcripts:
+        dest = out_dir / f"{transcript.id}.json"
+        dest.write_text(transcript.model_dump_json(indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
+        written.append(dest)
+    return written
